FAQ

Have questions? We have answers.

You can use a Synchrony Secured Installment loan to pay for your new or used powersport, marine and trailer products. This includes financing extended warranties, service and maintenance plans, add-on equipment, tax title and license and accessories into one loan.

You have the ability to finance Powersports purchases with a minimum amount of $2,500 and a maximum of $50,000; Trailer purchases have a minimum amount financed of $3,000 with a maximum of $25,000 and; Marine purchases have a minimum amount financed of $10,000 and a maximum of $100,000. With flexible payment options, you can get a monthly payment that helps fit the cost into your budget and lifestyle.

Financing is available up to 84 months on powersports and trailer products and up to 180 months on marine products.*/**

Yes, you can include warranties for powersports vehicles and equipment in your monthly payment with one Synchrony Secured Installment loan.

When the loan is paid off the title will be released, and the equipment is yours free and clear.

Simply fill out the consumer application, which requires your first and last name, social security number, address and income.

Synchrony offers assistances for those experiencing hardships and unable to make payments on their loan. Please call 1-866-220-9432, or reach out to Customer Service to learn about available repayment options.

To access the payment portal, visit secured.syf.com. Login in by providing your account number, last 4 digits of your SSN, and the zip code on your account (where statements are sent). Within the portal you can enroll in autopay, make payments on your installment account same-day, or you can schedule a payment up to 30 days in advance. For additional assistance, call our Customer Service number (1-866-220-9432).

*Offer subject to credit approval by Synchrony Bank.
